title: Datapack manifest
description: A versioned, content-addressed bundle of world data. Data only -- a datapack never contains executable code.

version.description: Semver. Major bump = ids retired or constraint semantics changed.

extent.description: Entity id this pack is authoritative within. Higher specificity wins at resolution time.

license.description: SPDX identifier. Packs deriving from ODbL sources must themselves be ODbL and must be distributed separately -- see docs/02-data-spine.md section 6.

provenance_summary.description: Counts by tier. Surfaced in the studio's synthesis diff and in the player-facing survey completeness map mode.

boundary_depiction.description: soi-current: follows Survey of India depiction, required for any current-boundary layer distributed in India. historical: a dated historical depiction, not a claim about present boundaries. See docs/00-plan.md section 5.

min_ground_resolution_m.description: Finest ground resolution of surveyed data in this pack. Must be >= 1 to stay above India's Geospatial Data Guidelines 2021 threshold. Sub-metre detail is generated by worldgen, never shipped.
